notes: Praxion is plugin/philosophy infrastructure (skills, agents, rules, commands, hooks) plus Python harnesses — not a deployed service. These weights down-rank pillars whose criteria assume a runtime service (health checks, containerization) so the adjusted score reflects what matters for this repo. The canonical unweighted Factory score is still computed and shown for cross-tool comparison. Tune freely: weight 0 excludes a pillar entirely. See skills/agent-readiness.
